module: DK-06 · Document and form template management
notice: Hashes below are SHA-256 over the repository file with CRLF normalised to LF for text content, and byte for byte for binary content. Normalisation is required because .gitattributes sets eol=lf only for some extensions, so a Windows checkout holds the .ts, .css and .js sources with CRLF while the committed blobs are LF. The builder refuses to assemble if any of these changes, so a shared source or asset change is a reviewed event rather than a silent one.

reused_components.docs/design/supplier-pricing/fonts.css: Embedded PPO Roboto assets, reused unchanged from the pinned Supplier Pricing source family.
reused_components.docs/design/supplier-pricing/workspace.c: r20-aligned primitives: typography, tokens, controls, tabs, tables, cards, dialogs, status labels, focus treatment and responsive snapshots.
reused_components.docs/reference/ui/theme-style-board/powe: Page types, navy/green/paper tokens, 6 px control and 7 px card radii, Roboto with Verdana fallback.

dependency_references.notice: The definition dependency manifests inside model.js quote the fingerprints above for the renderer, font and branding sources. They are references for impact demonstration; the prototype never modifies those files.

profile_capabilities.html-a4-r2: Supported. Real local HTML rendered from the exact definition and an audience-filtered sample.
profile_capabilities.form-capture-r1: Supported. Structured form capture against the sample fixture only.
profile_capabilities.pdf-ua-r1: Not supported in this build. No PDF bytes are produced, so no PDF or PDF/UA claim is made.

declared_departures: The demonstration clock is a local scenario control, not trusted server time or a scheduled publication service.
The definition fingerprint is a real SHA-256 over a canonical serialisation, computed in the page by a bundled synchronous implementation verified against node:crypto in the model checks.
Local storage is not an ACID database, a secure audit log or a multi-user concurrency solution; cross-tab checks refuse stale saves without claiming database guarantees.
Preview profiles demonstrate intended interface behaviour only. They do not secure embedded fixture content from anyone holding the file.
The form fixture engine has no pinned runtime digest and is recorded with a null hash rather than an invented integrity value.

Pinned source hashes are taken over line-ending-normalised text so the builder gives the same result on Windows and Linux, and the artifact is written with explicit LF. Raw-byte hashing reported an unchanged source as changed on a Windows checkout.
